# FDN Burglar Rat: "When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card."
# Event: the compiler's "When this creature enters". Effect: M20 Yarok's Fenlurker's verified
# "each opponent exiles a card from their hand" (EachPlayer(ALL_OPPONENTS, the hand move with the
# inner effect YOU-relative: the rotated opponent chooses from their own hand) with the discard's
# destination, the graveyard (Teferi's Tutelage's "discard a card": hand to graveyard, the chooser
# the controller). Not Bad Deal's plural `controller` role: with one card the canonicalizer makes
# that pick a ONE_OF over every hand, asked of the caster (compiler.PICK_ASK_FORCE_SILENT's L-27),
# which the probe showed raising "not in the hand of player:1" when it offered your own cards.
etb = TriggeredAbility(
    event=ZoneChangeEvent(
        from_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.ANY, controller=ControllerRef.ANY),
        to_zone=Zone(kind=ZoneKind.BATTLEFIELD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        subject=FAtom(pred=FAtomPred.IS_SOURCE),
    ),
    condition=None,
    effect=EachPlayer(
        ref=ControllerRef.ALL_OPPONENTS,
        effect=A(Verb.MOVE_ZONE, {
            'cards': Selector(
                count=QConst(value=1),
                mode=SelectorMode.CHOOSE,
                filter=FAnd(children=()),
                zones=(Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),),
            ),
            'controller': ControllerRef.YOU,
            'destination': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.GRAVEYARD, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
            'from': Zone(kind=ZoneKind.HAND, controller=ControllerRef.YOU),
        }),
    ),
)
abilities = [etb, *compiled]

clauses.clause: When this creature enters, each opponent discards a card.

mapping.notes: Each opponent discards a card: Yarok's Fenlurker's verified EachPlayer(ALL_OPPONENTS, hand move, the rotated opponent choosing from its own hand) to the graveyard. Not Bad Deal's plural `controller` role: with one card the canonicalizer makes it a ONE_OF over every hand asked of the caster (PICK_ASK_FORCE_SILENT, L-27); the probe of that form raised 'not in the hand of player:1' when it offered your own cards. Packs: tools/scenarios/mapped/FDN/burglar_rat_each_opponent_discards_in_three_seats.json.
